_source: CBP ruling N342838 (18 Oct 2024): bulb irrigation syringe, soft bulb moulded in China, barrel and sealing ring moulded and the syringe assembled in Vietnam: CBP held China. In the selection pool; excluded. The barrel and the bulb are both in the moulded group, so moving the group moves the bulb.

product.name: Bulb irrigation syringes (Items 47394 and 00943)
product.description: Bulb irrigation syringes (in 50 ml and 60 ml capacities) designed for the irrigation of wounds and surgical sites with liquids during medical and surgical procedures. Each syringe consists of a molded clear hard PVC barrel with raised volume graduations, a detachable soft TPE plastic bulb, and a thin molded PVC sealing ring between the barrel and the bulb.

components.name: Molded hard PVC plastic barrel body with raised graduations
Thin molded PVC plastic sealing ring

operations.name: Injection mold clear hard PVC barrels with raised graduations from PVC resin
Injection mold thin PVC sealing rings from PVC resin
Place sealing ring at the top neck of the barrel
Press fit soft plastic bulb into the top neck of the barrel
Clean, inspect, and test assembled syringes for leaks, and package for shipment
